premise: defect: a single-threaded LRU churn spends its time in futex and sched_yield of the GC marking helpers (oven-sh/bun#44893); one GC marker is 2 times faster
pick: on-request-helpers (oven-sh/WebKit#838): the marking pays for each wake-up of a marker (one per minimumBytesMarkedForParallelMarking visited), no helper parks in a collection, wake-ups happen with m_markingMutex released
pick_reason: the component that wakes every parked helper for every shared cell is SlotVisitor::donateKnownParallel and the helper protocol of the Collector; the fix belongs there, for every collection size, and not in a threshold for when the helpers join (WebKit#800), which covers collections under 1 MB only
why_not_minimal: a higher threshold in #800 (the minimal patch) makes a wide 10 MB collection mark on one thread and leaves every larger linked collection with the wake-up storm; one wake-up per donated segment still wakes 8 threads for 0.2 ms of marking in a Map
plan: zero per-cell cost in SlotVisitor::drain and untouched lock-free early-outs of donateKnownParallel
one wake function with the payment check inside; every futex wake after m_markingMutex is released
large cycles: request the paid-for deficit at each resume; a dry helper polls the shared stacks for a bounded time before it leaves
a cycle that asked for nobody stays paused, in Collector::runFixpointPhase, for every scheduler
the option at 0 keeps the upstream protocol (changed during the build: 'no payment' was worse than upstream on trees and in collectContinuously)
bun tests: wake-ups per collection at 4,096 and 131,072 entries; helpers mark a 40 MB full collection; option 0 at the race-test sites
ship: WebKit merges first, the pin moves to the merged sha
measurements: drain loop instructions per cell, main vs PR (objdump): 55 vs 55
repro: ns/op, system CPU, voluntary context switches, wake-ups per collection
125 MB churn: bytes marked in pauses, headroom used up, peak RSS, pauses

gates_outcome.gate2_large_cycle_parity: not met for RSS: 798-814 MB vs 678-706 MB on main; total pause not longer; cause measured (the mutator no longer waits for m_markingMutex in Collector::runConcurrentPhase)
